Art direction: POOLSIDE MODERNISM. A joyous architectural UI inspired by a Danish design hotel's swimming pool. Off-white and deep ultramarine with a vivid tangerine accent. Large uninterrupted very pale aqua upper surface, sparse precise cobalt tile grout grid below the central stats, beautifully photographed small circular sunlit water reflection as the hero artistic detail, no full photographic background. Bright clean unusual resort serenity and beautiful Swiss grid rigor combined. This is an app, not a hotel booking screen.
